summary: Iter 163 bug-fix verification (both backend + frontend). BOTH BUG FIXES ARE VERIFIED WORKING. (1) GET /api/ops/project-assignments returns pm_users (3 users, all role=project_manager) and coord_users (0) filtered correctly — no sales/safety/vendor leakage; inactive users are excluded. Because role_catalog has no labels literally named 'Manager O P' / 'Executive O P', the backend fallback keys [project_manager] / [project_coordinator, pro_coor] are used — this is the code's designed graceful fallback. (2) GET /api/admin/users returns all users; status=active|inactive filters work; toggle-active flow verified end-to-end (user disappears from ?status=active and appears in ?status=inactive, still visible in full list). Frontend Users page loads inactive+active from unfiltered API, filter dropdown works. Assignment Manager UI dropdowns only show filtered PM/Coord users. Bulk Transfer dialog renders and opens correctly. 4/4 pytest tests pass.

minor.issue: role_catalog does not contain any role with label 'Manager O P' or 'Executive O P' — backend silently falls back to legacy role keys (project_manager / project_coordinator / pro_coor). If the user's intent was to strictly restrict to those literal labels, a data-seed is required in role_catalog. Currently the fallback keeps the app working sensibly but does not literally enforce the label match.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog backdrop appears semi-transparent — labels and body text from behind bleed through the modal (visible overlap between 'Transfer FROM' / 'Transfer TO' labels and underlying row content). Possible z-index / bg-opacity issue on DialogContent.

issues: Modal background not fully opaque; text underneath shows through

action_items: OPTIONAL: If user truly requires dropdowns to be gated by literal role_catalog labels 'Manager O P' / 'Executive O P', seed those two roles in role_catalog (or rename existing project_manager/project_coordinator labels). Currently, silent fallback to legacy role keys is what the DB exercises.
OPTIONAL (LOW): Fix Bulk Transfer dialog backdrop opacity — DialogContent bg appears transparent in current build.
critical_code_review_comments: assignment_router.py _role_keys_by_label falls back to legacy keys when catalog label is missing — good defensive design, but silently masks catalog data-seed misses; consider logging a warning.
admin_router.py /users endpoint correctly toggles between q={} (all), active:{$ne:False}, active:False; behaviour is correct and matches the frontend UserManagement.jsx filter logic (line 73).
seed_data_creation: None. No permanent data was created. The toggle-active test toggles a non-admin user off then restores it in a try/finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint for Bug 1 is /api/ops/project-assignments (NOT /api/assignments/users as stated in the review request — router prefix is /ops/project-assignments and the endpoint returns pm_users+coord_users inline in the root GET). Frontend routes: /app/admin/project-assignments and /app/admin/users. Login inputs use data-testid=login-email and login-password (no type=email attribute). Preview DB currently has 22 users, all active; 3 with role=project_manager, 0 with role=project_coordinator. role_catalog has 20 roles but NONE with label 'Manager O P' or 'Executive O P' — backend falls back to legacy keys.
rca of the issue: Both fixes verified. The 'Manager O P' / 'Executive O P' label match currently never matches any catalog row, so the fallback list is what filters the dropdown. If the user reports the dropdown still shows wrong roles, root cause is missing role_catalog rows with those exact labels — main agent should either (a) seed role_catalog with labels 'Manager O P' and 'Executive O P' pointing to the appropriate keys, or (b) rename project_manager label to 'Manager O P' and project_coordinator label to 'Executive O P'.
